description: When a test fails because a locator no longer finds its element. Pass the locator line as it is in the file (its // COR cor:… comment included) or its id, with the page open where the element should be. COR opens the committed record for that id, tries the locators it recorded while this one worked, then the element's fingerprint, and proposes a graded replacement — or declines. It never edits a file. With no id, it lists the elements on this page whose recorded locators all fail.

id.description: The entry's id (the 6 characters after cor:).

locator.description: The broken locator line, its cor: comment included.

name: cor_heal
title: Propose a replacement for a broken locator
